content.text:
This confirms the state right before the bug was introduced: at `d82256d` (the parent of `72940a4`), `gridview.setAdapter(imageAdapter)` was still called unconditionally in `onCreateView()` right after `updateUI()`, regardless of which branch `updateUI()` took. The very next commit, `72940a4`, removed that line and relocated `setAdapter()` into the async network-response callback — breaking the guarantee.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 72940a4d8845f4690a5910f61c618c067d22c287

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I ran `git log --follow -p` on `MainActivityFragment.java` to see the full history of the file leading up to the fix commit `8e40fb2`, which simply re-adds `gridview.setAdapter(imageAdapter);` right after `gridview = (GridView) mainFragmentView.findViewById(R.id.gridView);` in `onCreateView()`. Since the fix is a one-line re-addition of a previously-removed statement, the bug-introducing commit should be whichever commit removed/relocated that exact call.

**(2) The specific change:** Commit `72940a4d8845f4690a5910f61c618c067d22c287` removed `gridview.setAdapter(imageAdapter);` from its original unconditional location in `onCreateView()` (right after `findViewById`) and moved it inside a `getActivity().runOnUiThread(...)` `Runnable` nested inside the success callback of the asynchronous Volley network request in `getMovies()`. Crucially, `onCreateView()` calls `updateUI()`, which only calls `getMovies()` when `movies.size() == 0`; otherwise it calls `resetImageAdapter()` (which only updates the adapter's internal data, never touches `gridview`). So after this commit, `gridview.setAdapter()` is executed only on the "first load" code path — any time the fragment view is recreated while `movies` is already populated (e.g., after a configuration change/orientation rotation, since `movies` is a `static` field), the newly-created `GridView` never gets an adapter attached, leaving it blank.

**(3) Supporting evidence:** I confirmed by diffing the file at the parent commit `d82256d` vs. `72940a4` — at `d82256d`, `gridview.setAdapter(imageAdapter)` is still called unconditionally in `onCreateView()`; immediately after `72940a4`, it only exists inside the async `Runnable`. No subsequent commit (`efd83a2`) restores it before the fix commit `8e40fb2` does. This matches the fix exactly: `8e40fb2` just re-adds the missing unconditional `setAdapter()` call that `72940a4` had removed.

I'm fairly confident in this identification since the fix is a minimal, surgical one-line change that directly reverses what `72940a4` did to that same line.
